title: New user? Start here · the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab
description: How a new user of the AI Foundry ET-SoC-1 lab starts, in three steps: from their own computer, log in as root once to create their own account, then log in as that account and start Claude on the lab machine in tmux; then give that Claude one line, which has it read the lab's brief, pick a free card, run a first test and keep to the lab's rules.
